name: Zhiloj dom №9
source:
There was never a house there. 
Never been near the railway much — my neighborhood (was) on the other side of town. And still, I know for sure: nothing used to be here. Just the wasteland. So why does the wall flyer say they need a new janitor?

You know what? There's a bigger question: why is this house actually right in front of me now?

And just when I have nowhere to live, of all times. Something is fishy there, but I have no other choice. Either way, better be a part of some obscure house than another name on a missing poster.
